traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are close together, violet in color.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are close together, violet in color.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Convex to broadly convex, occasionally nearly flat when mature; deep violet, often with a slightly campanulate or bell-shaped center.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Convex to broadly convex, occasionally nearly flat when mature; deep violet, often with a slightly campanulate or bell-shaped center.

traits.label: Hymenium attachment
traits.text: Adnate to adnexed, sometimes sinuate.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium attachment: Adnate to adnexed, sometimes sinuate.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, sometimes slightly swollen in the middle, with a violet hue throughout; often fibrillose or covered in fine, velvety scales.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, sometimes slightly swollen in the middle, with a violet hue throughout; often fibrillose or covered in fine, velvety scales.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: reddish-brown.
traits.raw: 🔴🟤 reddish-brown.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal, primarily associating with deciduous trees in mixed and coniferous forests, especially with birches and pines.
traits.raw: 🌳🌲 Mycorrhizal, primarily associating with deciduous trees in mixed and coniferous forests, especially with birches and pines.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Not recommended for consumption due to potential confusion with toxic species.
traits.raw: 😐 Not recommended for consumption due to potential confusion with toxic species.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Cap 6-10 cm in diameter, stipe up to 15 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 Cap 6-10 cm in diameter, stipe up to 15 cm tall.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Renowned for its striking violet hue stands out among other fungi. The vibrant coloration is present both on the cap and stipe.
traits.raw: 🔤 Renowned for its striking violet hue stands out among other fungi. The vibrant coloration is present both on the cap and stipe.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are ellipsoid, 9-11 x 5-6.5 µm, with a rough surface.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are ellipsoid, 9-11 x 5-6.5 µm, with a rough surface.
